## [1.0.1-dev.1](https://github.com/[secure]/ary-live/compare/v1.0.0...v1.0.1-dev.1) (2026-10-06)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* Stage custom launcher icons through ResourcePatchContext ([e31442a](https://github.com/[secure]/ary-live/commit/e31442ab6a3c77dea24fd6fabf5a5bc89d9c3d71))

patches.name: Bypass PairIP license check
patches.description: Skips PairIP / Play license dialog so resigned sideload builds can open.

patches.name: Custom branding
patches.description: Adds options to change the app icon and app name. Select Original for the real ARY PLUS logo, or Custom for the Morphe-style blue plus.

options.description: Launcher name shown under the icon. Default is the original ARY PLUS name.

Select Original to keep the real ARY PLUS lime-plus logo.
Select Custom to use the Morphe-style blue plus (same look as other Morphe-patched apps).

This is applied while patching. To switch later, patch again.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Disables interstitials, banners, native ads, Revive ads, home feed ad injectors, and IMA video ads. Shows Video ads skipped when drama/player ads are blocked.
